$comment: Banned vocabulary and banned tone for user-facing copy (SCRUM-123). The lists come from the ticket and match the header of apps/mobile/src/screens/copy.ts. Each head word maps to the inflections that carry the same meaning. Matching is on whole words, case-insensitive. A reviewer approving this file is approving these inflections too: note that 'missing' is deliberately NOT a form of 'missed', and 'conditional'/'conditioning' are deliberately NOT forms of 'condition'. Adding a form here can turn CI red on existing copy, which is intended.
